description: Verify an email address with Hunter.io email verification. Checks deliverability, MX records, SMTP, and whether the address is disposable or webmail. Returns a status, result, and confidence score. Example: email_verifier({ email: "patrick@stripe.com" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Hunter.io API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: email_verifier
title: Email Verifier
